about: Memory search set in English: an owner's facts and questions to them. expect — indices of facts (from zero) that must be in the top five; an empty expect — a question memory must stay silent on. kind — direct, paraphrase (other words), loan (another spelling of a borrowed word), root (a word of the same root), name, number, silence. Written by a model, checked by a person selectively.
